panels.title: Lifecycle Events (Range)
panels.description: Total operation events in the selected range. A transaction normally contributes CREATED, PENDING and one terminal event.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(operation_event_count), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

panels.title: Terminal Success Rate
panels.description: SUCCESS / (SUCCESS + FAILED). CREATED and PENDING lifecycle events are excluded from the denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(success_count + failed_count), 0), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

panels.title: Terminal Failure Rate
panels.description: FAILED / (SUCCESS + FAILED). CREATED and PENDING lifecycle events are excluded from the denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(failed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(success_count + failed_count), 0), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

panels.title: Currently Non-terminal
panels.description: Latest state of transactions created in the selected range. Each transaction is counted once.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, txn_id) region, tenant_scope, txn_id, provider, txn_type, is_terminal, raw FROM canonical_event WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND event_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, txn_id, event_time DESC, event_id DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest WHERE NOT is_terminal AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND COALESCE(raw->'__monitoring__'->>'channel_raw', '') LIKE '$channel';

panels.title: Currently Pending >= 60m
panels.description: Latest state is CREATED/PENDING and age is at least 60 minutes, among transactions created in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, txn_id) region, tenant_scope, txn_id, provider, txn_type, status, created_at, is_terminal, raw FROM canonical_event WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND event_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, txn_id, event_time DESC, event_id DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM latest WHERE NOT is_terminal AND status IN ('CREATED','PENDING') AND created_at <= CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) - INTERVAL '60 minutes' AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND COALESCE(raw->'__monitoring__'->>'channel_raw', '') LIKE '$channel';

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(freshness_lag_seconds), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel';

panels.title: Lifecycle Event Volume by Provider
panels.description: Canonical event throughput, not unique transaction count. A normal transaction emits multiple lifecycle events.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, CONCAT(provider, ' / ', region) AS metric, SUM(operation_event_count) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start, provider, region ORDER BY window_start;

panels.title: Terminal Success and Failure Rate
panels.description: Rates use only terminal outcomes: SUCCESS + FAILED.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, 100.0 * SUM(success_count) / NULLIF(SUM(success_count + failed_count), 0) AS "Success rate", 100.0 * SUM(failed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(success_count + failed_count), 0) AS "Failure rate" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

panels.title: Lifecycle Status Events by Window
panels.description: Historical lifecycle events. CREATED/PENDING here means a transaction passed through that state, not that it is still pending now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(success_count) AS "SUCCESS events", SUM(failed_count) AS "FAILED events", SUM(pending_count) AS "CREATED/PENDING events", SUM(unknown_count) AS "UNKNOWN events" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

panels.title: Latest-State Pending Age by Last Event Window
panels.description: Pending-age snapshots calculated from the latest known non-terminal state. The point is assigned to the window containing that transaction's latest event.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(pending_age_lt_5m_count) AS "< 5m", SUM(pending_age_5_to_15m_count) AS "5-15m", SUM(pending_age_15_to_60m_count) AS "15-60m", SUM(pending_age_gte_60m_count) AS ">= 60m" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

panels.title: Terminal Failure Breakdown
panels.description: Failure rate is calculated only from terminal outcomes: FAILED / (SUCCESS + FAILED).

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider, region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, txn_type, COALESCE(NULLIF(channel_raw, ''), 'unknown') AS channel, SUM(success_count + failed_count) AS terminal_sample_size, SUM(failed_count) AS failed, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(failed_count) / NULLIF(SUM(success_count + failed_count), 0), 2) AS failure_rate FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY provider, region, tenant_scope, txn_type, channel_raw HAVING SUM(success_count + failed_count) > 0 ORDER BY failure_rate DESC, terminal_sample_size DESC;

panels.title: Currently Stuck Transactions
panels.description: Latest state only; each transaction is counted once. The cohort contains transactions created in the selected dashboard range.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (region, tenant_scope, txn_id) region, tenant_scope, txn_id, provider, txn_type, status, created_at, is_terminal, raw FROM canonical_event WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND event_time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY region, tenant_scope, txn_id, event_time DESC, event_id DESC) SELECT provider, region, COALESCE(NULLIF(tenant_scope, ''), '-') AS tenant, txn_type, COALESCE(NULLIF(raw->'__monitoring__'->>'channel_raw', ''), 'unknown') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS currently_non_terminal, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) - created_at)) >= 900 AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) - created_at)) < 3600) AS pending_15_to_60m, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) - created_at)) >= 3600) AS pending_over_60m, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) - created_at)))::bigint AS oldest_pending_seconds FROM latest WHERE NOT is_terminal AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING') AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND COALESCE(raw->'__monitoring__'->>'channel_raw', '') LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY provider, region, tenant_scope, txn_type, COALESCE(NULLIF(raw->'__monitoring__'->>'channel_raw', ''), 'unknown') ORDER BY pending_over_60m DESC, oldest_pending_seconds DESC;

SELECT window_start AS time, CONCAT(provider, ' / ', region) AS metric, 100.0 * SUM(late_event_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0) AS value FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start, provider, region ORDER BY window_start;

SELECT window_start AS time, SUM(parse_error_count) AS "Parse errors", SUM(invalid_amount_count) AS "Invalid amount", SUM(missing_currency_count) AS "Missing currency" FROM window_aggregate WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND window_size_minutes = ${window_size:raw} AND region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' AND channel_raw LIKE '$channel' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start;

list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM window_aggregate ORDER BY region

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tenant_scope FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' ORDER BY tenant_scope

list.name: provider
list.label: Provider
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' ORDER BY provider

list.name: txn_type
list.label: Transaction type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT txn_type FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' ORDER BY txn_type

list.name: channel
list.label: Channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT channel_raw FROM window_aggregate WHERE region LIKE '$region' AND tenant_scope LIKE '$tenant' AND provider LIKE '$provider' AND txn_type LIKE '$txn_type' ORDER BY channel_raw
